scope: Cold compilation of the self-only precise-QK diagnostic. No worker restart or math changes; warm/sampler timings occur after profiling. Native sampling briefly pauses the compiler, so first-inference time includes profiling effects.
profiler: py-spy0.4.3 installed in an isolated external tools directory; no project/runtime dependency change.
finding: Bounded compiler sampling observed 374 Python samples at XLA warm-up-cache compilation. 14 of 49 native leaf samples resolve to ConstevalForwardAnalysis::valueTracesToConstantArgs; other leaves include LLVM pointer sets and strings. This is a short compilation window, not whole-compile pass attribution or device-kernel profiling. Both sampling windows ended before native runtime IR emission and sampler timing.
source_audit: The pinned analysis already caches reachability and marks that cache dirty on rewrite events, rebuilding lazily. These samples do not measure invalidation or cache-miss rates; no cause or compiler fix is proven.
reproduce: While a native run.py worker is compiling, py-spy record --pid <pid> --nonblocking --duration 15 --rate 25 --format raw --output <new>; separately --native --duration 10 --rate 5. Native+nonblocking is unsupported. Resolve recorded native addresses using the contemporaneous library mapping and exact wheel binary.
